### How to Live the Bible — The Name of Jesus
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2021/11/how-to-live-the-bible-the-name-of-jesus/
Passage: Matthew 1:21
Points:
- Ancient names carried profound significance and revealed a person's true calling and identity.
- The name Jesus means "the Lord saves," announcing His divine mission from the very beginning.
- Human beings are completely incapable of rescuing themselves from the guilt and power of sin.
- The work of redemption did not begin on Good Friday, but commenced with Christ's incarnation in Bethlehem.
- Believers today can see what Mary and Joseph could not yet fully grasp: the completed saving love of God.

### Is There Room in Your Inn?
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-december-19-2016.html
Passage: Luke 2:7
Points:
- It is easy to participate in cultural Christmas celebrations while entirely missing Jesus.
- The innkeeper in Bethlehem turned away Mary and Joseph because his lodging business was bustling.
- Preoccupation with work and success blinded the innkeeper to the arrival of the Son of God.
- Packed schedules, holiday stress, and daily distractions frequently crowd Jesus out of our hearts.
- Christmas presents an invitation to clear room in our lives and walk in personal relationship with God.
